newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AUSTRALIA TELECOMS-Telstra says retail business may suffer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AUSTRALIA TELECOMS-Telstra says retail business may suffer.

text.p: Telstra Corp admits its retail business may suffer with the growth of second-tier carriers after full industry deregulation next July, but it plans to dominate Australia's wholesale telecommunications market.

"Obviously we'll fight very hard at the wholesale level to hopefully get the lion's share of the wholesale market, while our retail revenues may suffer," Telstra group director of regulatory and external affairs Graeme Ward told Reuters.
Growth in second-tier or niche providers was inevitable after the open market emerged, he said.
